title: Arithmetic selection commutes with the strict scalar image mate
statement: Let l be prime, E and F finite extensions of the l-adic field ℚ_l with a ℚ_l-algebra map E → F, c a compactification of a scheme morphism X → Y, e ≥ 1, and K any object of the derived category of constant E-integral strict towers on X. Apply the E/F image comparison to e-selection of K, then the image of the tensor/selection comparison on X and inverse image/selection comparison over F. This equals inverse image/selection over E under scalar tensor on Y, followed by the tensor/selection comparison on Y and e-selection of the image comparison at K. This involves two coefficient fields and one ramification-independent positive arithmetic index, with no reduction or support-model data. The notation is fixed by [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-composition-prelude], [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data].

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6E and 0940; supportRealization_coherence proof, respectively reduction-balancing, scalar-selection, and nested-image-selection steps. Open tensor compatibility: sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I.

proof.text: On ordinary strict towers, arithmetic selection is precomposition with its index functor. Direct image, scalar restriction, constant scalar tensor, and open extension act termwise. Their sectionwise selection squares and units therefore commute, including every composite transition. The ordinary restriction/proper-image selection cube commutes by identity on sections.

Derive the cube with the canonical whole-complex units; positive selection preserves K-injectives. Normalized derived-square uniqueness transports the equality. Passing to scalar-adjunction mates gives the proper scalar-mate selection equation. Exact localization gives the open scalar-mate selection equation. Paste them in the order defining comparison and reindexImage; tensor/selection is the localized identity square compositionSelection. Naturality cancels the intermediate selection identifications.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_selection {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (K : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X) :
    (comparison l E F i c).app ((subsequence l E X e).obj K) ≫
        (image l F c).map ((compositionSelection l E F i X e).hom.app K) ≫
        (reindexImage l F c e he).inv.app ((T l E F i X).obj K) =
      (T l E F i Y).map ((reindexImage l E c e he).inv.app K) ≫
        (compositionSelection l E F i Y e).hom.app ((image l E c).obj K) ≫
        (subsequence l F Y e).map ((comparison l E F i c).app K)
